scope: Single-entry quality review of Mixo. Verified the current AI website builder, hosted business-site and lead-capture workflows, free plan restrictions, paid page limits and USD pricing, annual discount and current first-party product/help pages; refined the existing listing without changing lifecycle status.

accepted.name: Mixo
accepted.description: AI website builder for small businesses and founders. It generates hosted, responsive business websites from a short description, with editable content, contact forms, enquiry tracking and exports, blog, SEO/GEO features, and third-party integrations.
accepted.userValue: For solo operators, small businesses and early-stage founders who need a hosted marketing site to collect enquiries, not a custom web application. Free plan: one page on a Mixo subdomain with branding; paid plans are $9/month Basic (one page), $19 Growth (up to five pages), and $39 Premium (up to 50 pages), with a 20% annual-billing discount. Hosting and SSL are included; custom domains and branding removal require a paid plan. Verify current regional pricing before purchase.

notes: Mixo is an active hosted AI website builder. The current official site describes generating responsive business websites from a short business description, with contact forms, enquiry tracking, contact export, blog, SEO/GEO optimization and integrations. Its feature page also documents no-code editing, hosting, SSL, responsive design and form capture.

The free plan allows a one-page site on a Mixo subdomain with Mixo branding, hosting, SSL and AI-generated content/design. Paid plans unlock custom domains, branding removal, more pages and advanced analytics/marketing integrations.

The official pricing help article lists Basic at $9/month for one page, Growth at $19/month for up to five pages, and Premium at $39/month for up to 50 pages, with a 20% discount for annual billing. Prices are in USD and may change; confirm the live checkout for regional taxes and currency.
Mixo is appropriate for small-business marketing sites and idea/lead validation, but it should not be described as a full-stack application builder or a substitute for custom app development.

Trustpilot shows recent 2026 customer reviews and a claimed profile; however, only nine reviews were posted in the last 12 months, so review volume is modest and should not be used as a definitive measure of broad customer satisfaction.
